characters.name: Ancient Leshen
characters.dataNote: Wolf health is per summoned token; the available token count was not captured.

characters.name: Angel
characters.dataNote: Angelus, Scourge of Europe has no visible effect text in the source.

characters.name: Black Widow
characters.dataNote: The 31 physical copies comprise a 30-card shuffled deck plus The Moscow Protocol, which starts in hand.

characters.name: Blackbeard
characters.dataNote: Sea Dog health is per summoned token; the available token count was not captured.

characters.name: Buffy
characters.dataNote: Choose either Giles or Xander before play. The source lists a 35-card pool: 25 shared cards plus one 5-card sidekick package, producing a 30-card deck.

characters.name: Cloak & Dagger
characters.dataNote: Dagger's attack type and health were not captured in the source workbook.

characters.name: Daredevil
characters.dataNote: Only 22 of the standard 30 physical deck cards were present in the source workbook.

characters.name: Deadpool
characters.dataNote: Every card is unique; several cards intentionally use real-world or fourth-wall conditions.

characters.name: Donatello
characters.dataNote: Heroes in a Half Shell has no legible effect text in the source.

characters.name: Elektra
characters.dataNote: Starting health records the first-life value; the ability instructs the player to flip the health dial on resurrection.

characters.name: Geralt of Rivia
characters.dataNote: The source lists a 36-card pool. Choosing one card from each of three two-copy GEAR pairs produces a 30-card deck.

characters.name: Golden Bat
characters.dataNote: Two card effects were not visible in the captured source.

characters.name: Krang
characters.dataNote: Uses three doomsday machines and the Dice of Ultimate Destruction; source placeholders for die results are retained.

characters.name: Little Red
characters.dataNote: The full effect text of What's That In My Basket? remains unconfirmed.

characters.name: Loki
characters.dataNote: Four TRICK cards can move into an opponent's hand; movement can increase above the printed value.

characters.name: Moon Knight
characters.dataNote: The source contains conflicting identity-cycle descriptions: the main ability uses Khonshu, while another component names Jake Lockley.

characters.name: Oda Nobunaga
characters.dataNote: The source's verified card-type corrections are reflected in the card rows.

characters.name: Pandora
characters.dataNote: The separate seven-card MISERY deck is described by the ability but is not included in the source card table.

characters.name: Raphael
characters.dataNote: Sai and Heroes in a Half Shell show no printed effect text in the source; they are retained as pure-value cards with review notes.

characters.name: Raptors
characters.dataNote: The Eviscerate card had no visible effect text in the captured source.

characters.name: Robin Hood
characters.dataNote: The source's verified banner and BOOST corrections are reflected in the card rows.

characters.name: Rosie the Riveter
characters.dataNote: The source reports Wendy's attack type as 'common', which is not a valid value; it remains blank pending confirmation.

characters.name: Shredder
characters.dataNote: Bebop and Rocksteady share one source stat block. Foot soldiers are path components rather than fighter stat lines.

characters.name: Spike
characters.dataNote: The source also records three Shadow tokens used by the ability; they are components, not fighter stat lines.

characters.name: Sun Wukong
characters.dataNote: Clone health is per summoned token; the available token count was not captured. The confirmed Tricked You bonus attack remains part of Ruyi Jingo Bang rather than a separate card.

characters.name: Titania
characters.dataNote: The separate glamour deck was not present in the captured source and is not included.

characters.name: Willow
characters.dataNote: Four source rows contain icon-dependent wording. Three are recorded as BLIND BOOST or transformation effects according to the source notes; Love and Loss retains an unresolved [icon] placeholder.

characters.name: Yennefer & Triss
characters.dataNote: The fighter rows show Yennefer as hero and Triss as sidekick for one legal setup. If Triss is chosen as hero, their roles and starting health values swap.
